item.title: CVE-2026-134430 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Frappe ERPNext 12.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns the parsed content of private import-format files without checking permission on the requested records. item.title: CVE-2026-134431 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Frappe ERPNext 7.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in endpoints that build part of a query from caller-supplied sort parameters without validation. item.title: CVE-2026-134432 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Frappe ERPNext 15.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module import endpoint that does not check whether the caller may create inserted records or download a named file. item.title: CVE-2026-134433 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.4
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.4 | Frappe ERPNext before 15.124.2 and 16.x before 16.53.0 fails to enforce record-level authorization in several endpoints, reports and forms, allowing authenticated low-privilege users to access data beyond their role. item.title: CVE-2026-134434 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3

item.title: CVE-2026-134435 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3

item.title: CVE-2026-134448 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6

item.title: CVE-2026-134458 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2 | web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.12, 4.0.x before 4.0.8, 4.1.x before 4.1.10, and 4.2.x before 4.2.4, and jwt-encryption-algorithm-ecdh-es through 3.2.10, have a ConcatKDF::generate() that performs a single SHA-256 round, deriving at most 32 bytes for ECDH-ES and ECDH-SS direct key agreement. Anyone holding a JWE using A256CBC-HS512 can decrypt it under an all-zero AES key, while A192CBC-HS384 content keys have only 64-bit strength.

item.title: CVE-2026-134459 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2

item.title: CVE-2026-134461 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Web-Token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.10, 4.0.0 before 4.0.7, and 4.1.0 before 4.1.7 contain an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in PBES2AESKW::unwrapKey(), which passes the attacker-controlled p2c JWE header value to hash_pbkdf2() without an upper bound. item.title: CVE-2026-125294 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 9.8
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 9.8 | The Nexter Blocks Pro plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 5.0.10 via the `tpgb_ajax_register_user()` function. This is due to a byte-level denylist on the `tpgb_acf_key[]` and `tpgb_acf[]` parameters that fails to block Unicode look-alike characters — such as U+1E87 and U+00E7 in a key like `ẇp_çapabilities` — whose UTF-8 byte sequences do not match any ASCII-based pattern check, while the database's default accent-insensitive collation (`utf8mb4_unicode_ci` / `utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci`) treats the decorated key as equivalent to the canonical `wp_capabilities` row, causing `update_user_meta()` to overwrite the newly registered user's role with `administrator`. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to register a new account bearing the full Administrator role, gaining complete control over the WordPress site including the ability to install plugins, modify files, and execute arbitrary code. The nonce required by the handler is publicly emitted on any page containing the tp-login-register block, making the full exploit chain — nonce retrieval, a single crafted registration POST, and the plugin's own `autologin` flow — trivially reachable on any default install where user registration is enabled. Successful exploitation causes the attacker's own account to receive the complete Administrator role.
